newsitem.title: MALTA: Euro-Med foreign ministers to meet in Malta.
newsitem.headline: Euro-Med foreign ministers to meet in Malta.

text.p: Foreign ministers from 27 European and Mediterranean countries are to meet in Malta on April 15 and 16 to review progress since the 1995 EU Euro-Med conference in Barcelona, Maltese Foreign Minister George Vella said on Wednesday.
He said the decision was taken by the European Union in Brussels on Wednesday after objections were made to Tunisia or Morrocco hosting the conference.

Vella said the new Maltese government saw Malta's selection as vindication of its policy of neutrality, which strengthened the island's potential as a meeting place for people of difference beliefs and ideologies.
